plugins.readme_text:
**English** · [简体中文](docs/readme/README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](docs/readme/README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/README_ja.md) · [한국어](docs/readme/README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](docs/readme/README_tr.md) · [Русский](docs/readme/README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](docs/readme/README_vi.md) · [ไทย](docs/readme/README_th.md) · [Deutsch](docs/readme/README_de.md) · [Español](docs/readme/README_es.md) · [Français](docs/readme/README_fr.md) · [Українська](docs/readme/README_uk.md) · [Polski](docs/readme/README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](docs/readme/README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](docs/readme/README_ar.md) · [فارسی](docs/readme/README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](docs/readme/README_id.md) · [Italiano](docs/readme/README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](docs/readme/README_el.md) # REA: Reverse Engineer Anything ### One MCP for reverse engineering across binaries, applications, and runtime behavior. **See a feature you like. Understand how it works, down to the binary level.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/rea-agents?style=flat-square&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-agents) [![MCP tool catalog](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-tool_catalog-5c4ee5?style=flat-square)](docs/mcp-contracts.md#generated-catalog) [![Node.js requirements](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-requirements-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](#what-you-can-analyze) [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/morluto/rea?style=flat-square)](https://skills.sh/morluto/rea/reverse-engineer-anything) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-f4c430?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1556595354999332884?logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=Discord&color=5865F2)](https://discord.gg/GkcryMnJDM) **[Website](https://reareverse.com/) · [Guides](https://reareverse.com/guides/) · [Showcases](https://reareverse.com/showcase/)** [Quick start](#quick-start) · [How REA works](#how-rea-works) · [What you can analyze](#what-you-can-analyze) · [Showcases](#showcases) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Documentation](#documentation) npx rea-agents setup
> [!IMPORTANT] > Get REA from [morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea), > [reareverse.com](https://reareverse.com/), or the [rea-agents npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-agents). > Follow the installation and release links from these official sources. A similar > repository name or copied README does not establish that a download is official.




Join the Reverse Engineering Community
Discord · Q&A · Show and Tell

--- See a feature in an app that you want in your own product? Ask your agent to investigate it with REA. It can inspect the app without its source code, explain how the feature works, show the evidence, and build a version for your project. REA connects your agent to tools for inspecting native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. You can also use the same tools from your terminal. Analysis runs locally, and results include the evidence and limitations behind each conclusion. Setup registers REA with your agent and installs matching workflow instructions. Native analysis can use an existing Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA installation; setup can optionally install Hopper with approval. Static JavaScript analysis needs no native analysis engine. > **[Visit the REA website](https://reareverse.com/)** for setup instructions, illustrated guides, and real case studies. ## Quick start On Linux, Ghidra, JADX, firmware tool launches and static JavaScript/Electron analysis require a procps-compatible `ps` on REA's `PATH` for process ownership checks. Recovery steps are in `docs/installation.md` under "Linux owned-process prerequisite". ### Set up your agent With Node.js and npm installed, run: ```bash npx rea-agents setup ``` Choose your agents, review the proposed changes, and approve them. Setup adds REA's MCP server and matching workflow instructions, with backups of existing configuration. Restart your agent afterward. Setup supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build and [other agents](docs/installation.md#supported-agents). See [installation and setup](docs/installation.md) for provider configuration and manual MCP registration. ### Ask your agent ```text Understand how search works in the Notes app, show me the evidence, and build a similar feature for my project. ``` Replace Notes with your target app and the feature you want to understand. ### Use the terminal Inspect an extracted JavaScript/Electron app directory or ASAR: ```bash npx -y rea-agents@latest analyze-javascript-application /absolute/path/to/app --json ``` The result includes modules, imports, Electron boundaries and their evidence. Replace the path with your target, such as `"D:/apps/example"` on Windows. To install the `rea` command for regular use: ```bash npm install --global rea-agents rea --help ``` For native analysis, configure a provider first. See the [CLI and Evidence guide](docs/cli.md) for native commands, provider selection, snapshots and scripting. ### Update REA REA changes quickly, and new releases include frequent bug fixes. Keep your installation up to date. For a CLI installed with `npm install --global` or `bun add --global`: ```bash rea update ``` Bun global updates require Bun 1.2.17 or later. With an older Bun release, upgrade Bun manually before running `rea update`. To refresh your agent registrations and skill, run the setup command printed by the update. If you use `npx`, update your agent setup with: ```bash npx rea-agents@latest setup ``` Review the setup changes and restart your agent. For one-off CLI commands, use `npx rea-agents@latest` followed by the command. With Bun, use `bunx rea-agents@latest` in place of `npx rea-agents@latest`. ## How REA works Your agent calls REA through MCP to inspect the target and trace relevant code. REA returns findings with their evidence. The agent uses them to ask follow-up questions, explain the behavior, or write and test an implementation. CLI commands use the same workflows. ![REA investigation flow: your agent asks about a local target, REA inspects and traces it using analysis tools, and the agent uses the returned code, references and unknowns to explain, implement and test.](website/public/assets/figures/rea-investigation-flow.svg) [Open the full-size figure](website/public/assets/figures/rea-investigation-flow.svg). ## What you can analyze REA requires Node.js 22.x (>=22.19), 24.x (>=24.11), or 26+, plus npm. Additional tools and host support depend on the target: | Target | What REA returns | Requirements and guide | | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Native binaries | Pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, calls and references | Hopper, Ghidra or IDA; [native analysis](docs/native-investigation.md) | | Offline ELF layout

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a pasted animated GIF or WebP keeps playing in the UI, and the model receives a labelled sheet of frames sampled across the animation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-read-animation

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the agent **actually see an animated GIF**.

`read_image` on a GIF gives the model one picture — the first frame — and no
signal that the other frames existed. This plugin decodes every frame and hands
the model a labelled sequence of real frames sampled across the animation's
timeline.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-read-animation
```

---

## The problem

DeepSeek Harness normalizes every stored image to a single-frame 8-bit sRGB
raster before it reaches a model, and it does this to animations too.
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` excludes `image/gif` from its pass-through
path and re-encodes through a pipeline that never sets `animated` or `page`, so
`sharp` returns page 0 and the rest are dropped on the floor.

Measured, on this machine, against an 8-frame GIF:

```
metadata:  {"format":"gif","width":240,"height":160,"pages":8,
            "delay":[80,80,80,80,80,80,80,80],"loop":0}
default -> 240x160  pages=1     ← what read_image delivers
animated -> 240x1280 pages=1    ← all eight frames, when asked for
```

No layer above the read step can repair this. By the time a vision plugin, an
image router, or the LLM adapter sees the image it is already a single frame —
which is why the growing ecosystem of DSH vision plugins
([`dsh-multimodal`](https://github.com/SCT192221/dsh-multimodal),
[`dsh-mmroute`](https://github.com/jmxsxwyzjdwl/dsh-mmroute),
[`dsh-vision-mix`](https://github.com/haiziyao/dsh-vision-mix),
[`dsh-tool-plus`](https://github.com/xiaoso456/dsh-tool-plus), …) all say they
"support PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF" without any of them showing you motion. The
animation is still intact in exactly one place: the file. So the tool lives
there.

Animated PNG has the same disease with a worse prognosis: libvips 8.18.7 does
not read `acTL`/`fcTL`/`fdAT` at all, reports an APNG as a one-page PNG, and
silently discards every frame after the first. This plugin detects that case from
the chunk stream and refuses it by name instead of returning frame 0.

## Two ways in, both handled

**Pasting into the chat box.** That path is already clean on the browser side: the
paste handler hands the clipboard's own `File` straight to the upload path, and
that path encodes `image/gif` and `image/webp` unchanged (`imageMediaType()`
accepts both and returns them as-is) — no canvas, no `drawImage`, no `toBlob`.
**The bytes reach the Host whole.** It is the Host that destroys them:
`admitPromptContent` runs every image through the single-frame normalizer and
keeps no copy of the source.

`admitPromptContent` is therefore the last moment the original bytes exist. The
plugin wraps it, decodes the animation and stores the frames — then **returns the
original result untouched**:

```
you paste 1 animation
   ├─ the message: unchanged — the picture you sent, not one word added
   ├─ the UI: the animation itself, played from the original bytes
   └─ the model: one sheet of its frames, each labelled with index and time
```

**What you send is what you send.** Nothing is added to the message you wrote,
and it does not turn into eight stills.

**And it keeps playing in the UI.** The Web UI has exactly one way to display a
durable image: `session.readAttachment(id)` → the Host's
`ctx.attachments.readImage(ref)` →
`URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: attachment.mediaType }))`. Both the
bytes and the media type come from that one host call, and the browser animates
whatever it is handed. So the plugin serves the original at that **display read** —
no client plugin, no media route, no second authorization path. The single frame
in the store is only a lossy artifact of a normalizer that cannot represent
motion; handing back the file the person actually pasted is the more truthful
answer to "read this stored image", and the other two callers of that layer (ACP
image blocks, session-log export) are better with an animation too.

Each captured frame carries its index and start time in its attachment display
name (`x.gif#frame16@1960ms`), which the harness renders to the model as
`Image "<name>" …` — so the timing is already attached to the frames, waiting
for the delivery step below.

**The display path and the model's are independent**: the UI is served the
original bytes by `readImage`, while the model's copy comes from
`readImageRequest`, which composes the sheet.

> **Where the frames are delivered**: `readImageRequest(ref, target, signal)` is
> the method each adapter calls to build its own copy of one image
> (`dsh-llm-deepseek` and `dsh-llm-pi-ai` both do), so it is the seam that reaches
> the model. It answers with exactly one image, so the frames are composed into one
> labelled sheet: a 4x2 grid for eight samples of a phone-shaped animation, every
> tile at its native size, with the frame index, duration and start time printed
> under each. Nothing is re-derived per request — the same stored attachment always
> produces the same sheet — and the sheet is built once and cached.
>
> The route that looks obvious, rewriting the request from an `llm/stream`
> listener, is closed by design: a loop-built request "arrives deep-frozen
> (mutation throws): its content is a pure function of the session log", so
> listeners may read it but never rewrite it. An earlier version of this plugin
> tried exactly that and silently did nothing, because the probe behind it used a
> hand-built request, which is the one case that documentation exempts.

**Files.** Animations in the workspace, or attached as files, still exist on
disk byte-for-byte; the `read_animation` tool below reads those.

## What it does

`read_animation(path, …)` returns one text header plus one captioned image per
sampled frame:

```
<path>D:\work\dance.gif</path>
<type>animation</type>
<content>
image/gif animation, 480x270 px, 24 frames, 1200 ms total, ~20 fps, loops forever.
Attached below are 6 frames sampled evenly in time from this animation. They are
consecutive moments of the SAME animation, in time order, not separate images;
each is preceded by its frame index and start time.
Only frames 0, 4, 9, 13, 18, 23 of 24 were sampled, so any motion between two
attached frames is not visible. Re-read with explicit "frames" indices to inspect
a specific moment, or a higher "max_frames" to sample more densely.
</content>
```

…then, for each frame:

```
frame 9 of 24 (sample 3) · starts at 450 ms · displayed for 50 ms
[ image ]
```

Everything the model needs to reason about *motion* is in that text: how long the
animation runs, how fast it plays, whether it loops, which frames it is looking
at, and — stated outright, because it is the easiest thing to get wrong — that
the gaps are gaps.

## Install

Needs **DSH 0.1.3-alpha.2 or later** — see [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md) for
the measured range, how it was measured, and what is not claimed.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-read-animation
```

Replace `web` with your profile name. Both routes are verified in a real profile:
the install lands, `dsh plugin add` registers the bundle, and the `sharp` native
binary resolves from the package's own `node_modules`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-read-animation                            # npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:NeoHotaru/dsh-read-animation#v0.1.0    # a tagged commit
```

The git route copies the whole repository, tests and fixtures included, which is
why npm is the nicer install. (A brand-new package name goes through npm's staged
publishing on its first release, so the version you install may briefly not exist
yet while the registry processes it.)

Or from a checkout:

```sh
cd dsh-read-animation
npm install                                     # fetches sharp
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
```

The same spec works in the Web sidebar's Plugins page, and in Settings the plugin
list is read-only. Restart the running instance afterwards: plugin rows take
effect on the next process, and a `link:`ed checkout is loaded once at startup.

## Usage

The model reaches for it on its own for a `.gif`, because the tool description
says to. You can also ask directly:

> what happens in this GIF? — `animations/loadi

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件：用 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）把 Codex、Claude Code 等外部 Agent 注册成模型提供方
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-tauri-acp DeepSeek Harness 桌面插件：用 ACP（[Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com)）把外部 Agent（Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等）注册成 dsh 的模型提供方。在模型选择器里选中它，对话就会交给这个 Agent 处理。 ## 插件界面 支持通过acp协议发现模型 支持导入标准acp配置json进行导入 ## 工作方式 - 每个配置项是一个 provider 路由，插件按需拉起该 Agent 子进程（stdio JSON-RPC），进程常驻复用。 - 每个 dsh 会话对应一个 ACP 会话，后续轮次只发送新增的用户消息；历史对不上（切过模型、被压缩）时自动新建 ACP 会话，并把历史压平成 `` 一次性带过去。Agent 收图时历史里的图片按原位置作为 `image` 块重发，不会被压成文本。 - 模型列表来自 Agent 的 `configOptions`（`category: "model"`），兼容旧版 `models` + `session/set_model`；`default` 表示用 Agent 自己的默认模型。 - 模型元数据来自 Agent 本身（需要时会先启动一次 Agent 探测，受 `discoverModels` 控制）： - **推理等级**：Agent 的 `thought_level` 选项映射成 dsh 的推理等级，模型选择器里出现「推理等级」菜单；选中的等级经 `session/set_config_option` 设置，Agent 会话初始的等级作为默认等级上报（选择器里打勾的那一项，不再额外出现 dsh 自己的 Default）；Agent 对当前模型不提供的等级会被忽略并记日志。 - **图片输入**：输入类型按 ACP 协议问 Agent 本人——`initialize` 应答里的 `promptCapabilities`。dsh 解析元数据时若还没人跟这个路由握过手，插件会先做一次握手（只握手，不开会话、不发轮次）把能力问出来，答案按路由记在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tauri-acp/prompt-capabilities.json`（连同启动命令的指纹，换了命令即作废），重启后首轮直接可用。声明 `promptCapabilities.image` 且 dsh 挂了附件服务时模型声明为 文本+图片，图片按 dsh 的请求尺寸（与 pi-ai 默认相同：≤4MP、≤1MB）重新编码后作为 ACP `image` 块发送。能力未知时不作声（dsh 把缺省读作「未知」并原样下发图片），而不是谎报纯文本——显式报纯文本会让 dsh 在进入插件之前就把图片换成文本占位。`imageInput` 可覆盖 Agent 漏报的能力。 - **上下文窗口**：优先用 `models[].contextWindow`，其次用 Agent 通过 `usage_update.size` 上报的大小（对话一轮后才知道，记在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-tauri-acp/context-windows.json`，重启后首轮直接可用），再次是模型 id、名称或描述里的 `1m` 标记（如 `claude-fable-5-1[1m]`、`(1M context)`，按 1000000 算），最后是 `contextWindow` 配置。ACP 在一轮对话前不提供窗口大小，所以从没跑过的模型首轮仍按配置值算。 - `agent_message_chunk` 映射为正文，`agent_thought_chunk`、工具调用、计划映射为推理块；`usage` 按会话累计值做差分。 - 工作目录取当前 dsh 会话的 workspace，取不到时回退到 `cwd` 配置或用户主目录。 - Agent 的权限请求默认走 dsh 原生审批框（`ctx.approval`）。 - 标题生成、压缩等辅助调用使用一次性 ACP 会话，不影响主会话。 ## 安装到桌面端 插件是标准的 dsh bundle 包（`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`）。先构建： ```bash git clone https://github.com/Fleey/deepseek-harness-acp.git cd deepseek-harness-acp npm install && npm run build ``` 然后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 里加上依赖和 bundle，重启桌面端： ```json { "dependencies": { "dsh-tauri-acp": "link:/path/to/deepseek-harness-acp" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-tauri-acp"] } } } ``` 然后在档案目录执行一次安装来建立链接。要用和桌面端相同的 pnpm（看 `node_modules/.modules.yaml` 里的 `packageManager`，当前是 11.8.0，需要 Node ≥ 22.13），否则 pnpm 会要求清空整个 `node_modules`： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && npx -y pnpm@11.8.0 install --prefer-offline --config.minimum-release-age=0 ``` link 模式下，插件会从本仓库的 `node_modules` 解析 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`，和宿主不是同一个实例。所以适配器的失败一律以带内 `finish` 返回，不依赖 `instanceof LlmError`。改完代码执行 `npm run build`，再重启桌面端即可生效。 也可以放进 dsh-desktop 仓库的 `packages/`，再加进 `dsh-tauri-bundle` 的依赖里随包内置。 ## 设置页 插件带一个客户端设置页：设置 → **ACP Agents**（排在官方「模型」页之后），不用手写 YAML 就能添加、编辑、删除 Agent。 - 表单字段：路由名、显示名、启动命令、参数（每行一个）、环境变量（每行一个 `KEY=VALUE`）、认证方法、权限策略、图片输入、模型列表。表单不展示的字段（`cwd`、`systemPrompt`、超时等）保存时原样保留。 - **导入 JSON**：粘贴其他 ACP 客户端的配置一次导入多个 Agent，支持 Zed 的 `agent_servers`（也认 `agentServers`）、本插件自己的 `agents` 段，或直接的 `{ "名称": { "command", "args", "env" } }` 映射，其他键（如 `default_mcp_settings`）忽略。名称转成路由名（`CodeBuddy Code` → `codebuddy-code`，没有字母数字的名称用 `agent`，重名加 `-2`），原名作为显示名。先预览：每项标「新增」或「覆盖」，缺 `command`、`args` 不是字符串数组、`env` 不是字符串映射的条目列为跳过。每项前有复选框（默认全选，可一键全选/全不选），只导入勾选的。覆盖已有路由时只替换显示名、命令、参数和环境变量，权限、认证方法、模型等设置保留。勾选的条目一次原子写入。没带 `PATH` 的条目（如 `codebuddy`、`traecli`）用的是桌面端自己的 `PATH`，从 Dock 启动时可能找不到命令，必要时改成绝对路径或在 env 里补 `PATH`。 - **发现模型**：按已保存的命令启动 Agent，读取它公布的模型并追加到列表（已有的行不动）。发现请求只能带路由名、带不了命令行，所以新 Agent 要先保存；编辑中未保存的命令修改也不会参与发现。发现结果不受 `models`、`discoverModels` 影响，总是 Agent 自己公布的列表。 - 保存经 `ctx.configForms.get('dsh-tauri-acp')` 原子写入本插件条目的配置（带 revision 防覆盖），落到档案的 `cordis.patch.yml`。`agents` 字段声明为 `.volatile()`：DSH 0.2 的设置服务只把 volatile 字段做成可编辑表单（没有它设置页不会出现），并在原处提交修改、触发 `loader/volatile-update`，宿主据此重新注册路由，不重启插件，下一次请求即生效。改名会先删旧路由再写新路由。写入被拒（例如别处同时改过）时会重新读取并提示。 - 由 bundle 层声明的 Agent 带 `YAML` 标记：可以在设置页覆盖字段，但不能改名或删除。 - 设置页面向 DSH NEXT（0.2 核心）：设置段按档案条目 id 分段，即 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入的 `dsh-tauri-acp`；条目 id 改了的话设置页不会出现。宿主会关闭这个条目自动生成的通用表单，并把模型页的 provider 目录指向同一个段。0.1 核心（`settings.installSection`，段名 `llm-acp`）宿主仍可用，但没有这个设置页。 - 档案不可写时只读展示。 ## 配置 除了设置页，也可以在档案的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）里覆盖插件配置： ```yaml - id: dsh-tauri-acp name: dsh-tauri-acp config: agents: codex: displayName: Codex (ACP) command: /Users/you/.nvm/versions/node/v22.12.0/bin/codex-acp authMethod: api-key env: OPENAI_API_KEY: sk-... claude-code: displayName: Claude Code (ACP) command: /usr/local/bin/npx args: [-y, '@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp'] permission: ask ``` 设置页保存的也是这一段配置。0.1 核心上同样的结构也可以写进 dsh 用户设置的 `llm-acp` 段，修改后下一次请求即生效。 | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `displayName` | 路由名 | 模型选择器里显示的名字 | | `command` / `args` | 必填 / `[]` | 启动 ACP Agent 的命令 | | `env` | `{}` | 追加给子进程的环境变量（在继承的环境之上） | | `cwd` | 会话 workspace | 子进程目录，以及取不到会话 workspace 时的 ACP 会话目录 | | `authMethod` | 无 | 握手后调用 `authenticate` 的方法 id；出错信息会列出 Agent 支持的方法 | | `models` | `[]` | 手动声明模型（`id`、`name`、`description`、`contextWindow`）；声明后不再自动发现 | | `discoverModels` | `true` | 未声明模型时，启动 Agent 读取它公布的模型列表 | | `permission` | `ask` | `ask` 走 dsh 审批框（无审批服务时降级为 `read-only`）；`allow` 全部允许；`read-only` 只允许 read/search/think/fetch；`reject` 全部拒绝 | | `imageInput` | `auto` | `auto` 按 Agent 在 ACP 握手里公布的 `promptCapabilities.image` 判断；`force` 不管公布什么都开（Agent 漏报时用）；`off` 一律按文本占位。没挂附件服务时三者都是纯文本 | | `systemPrompt` | `drop` | `forward` 会把 dsh 系统提示词包在 `` 里发给 Agent。dsh 提示词描述的是 dsh 自己的工具，一般不建议转发 | | `showToolCalls` | `true` | 把 Agent 的工具调用和计划显示在推理块里 | | `contextWindow` | `200000` | 上报给 dsh 的上下文窗口（用于压缩策略）；Agent 通过 `usage_update` 报告过大小、或模型带 `1m` 标记时以那个值为准 | | `startupTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 握手超时 | | `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 流式输出空闲超时，`0` 关闭 | ## 冒烟测试 ```bash npx tsx scripts/smoke.mts "$(command -v codex-acp)" ``` 只做握手和模型发现，不消耗额度。末尾加 `-- 你的问题` 会真正发一轮对话（会走 Agent 的计费），`ACP_MODEL`、`ACP_AUTH_METHOD` 环境变量可指定模型和认证方式。 ## 限制 - Agent 用的是它自己的工具，dsh 的工具（含 MCP）不会传给它；插件不会产出 `tool-call`，每轮由 Agent 自己跑完。 - 文件按文本占位发送（dsh 在进入任何适配器之前就把文件块换成了句柄文本，插件拿不到原始引用，所以 ACP 的 `resource`／`embeddedContext` 用不上）；Agent 不支持图片时图片也按文本占位。dsh 的内容块里没有音频，所以 ACP 的 `promptCapabilities.audio` 只做记录，没有可发的内容。 - 推理等级列表取自 Agent 最近一次会话（默认模型下）提供的等级，换模型后等级集合变化的话，以 Agent 实际接受的为准。 - 重试策略固定为不重试，避免 Agent 重复执行有副作用的操作。 - 从 Finder/Dock 启动的桌面端拿不到 shell 的 `PATH`，`command` 建议写绝对路径。 - 官方「模型」页里的 provider 编辑器是为 HTTP 接口设计的，ACP 路由请在「ACP Agents」页或 YAML 里配置；在模型页点开 ACP 路由的「编辑」时，官方编辑器里那行「其余字段在 cordis.patch.yml 中…(dsh-tauri-acp)」会被替换成指向「ACP Agents」页的提示。官方编辑器没有给插件留插槽，这是按 DOM 替换的：只改设置弹窗里以 `(dsh-tauri-acp)` 结尾的那一行，插件卸载时停止。 ## 开发 ```bash npm test npm run typecheck npm run build ``` `npm run build`（`tsdown.config.ts`）同时产出宿主入口 `dist/index.js`（ESM，Node）和客户端入口 `dist/client.cjs`：一个只向 DSH web 的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 注册工厂的 CJS 脚本，`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/*` 由宿主模块表提供，不打进包里。 - 客户端运行在 DSH 的 web 模块表里，只能 `require` 平台种子词（`react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`@deepseek-ai/*`）和档案里作为条目加载的包。所以客户端只依赖 `react` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，设置读写、文案、槽位都走 `ctx.configForms` / `ctx.locale` / `ctx.slots` / `ctx.remote.llm` 服务；不能用 `dsh-tauri` / `dsh-tauri-ui`（DSH NEXT 档案里没有它们，会报 `require("dsh-tauri") missed the module table`）。构建后可以检查：`grep -o 'require(\`[^\`]*\`)' dist/client.cjs`。 - 样式自带（`src/client/styles/agents.ts`，挂成 `

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: delete sessions from the running Web runtime — live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts. Host half + web client half in one package.
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-dialogue-cleanup

English · 简体中文

Delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the running Web GUI — without restarting, without leaving the window.

One row in the session ... menu for a single delete, plus a bulk management page inside Settings.

Install · Gallery · How it works · Releasing · Releases

## Why it exists **One-line positioning: deleting a session should actually delete it.** DeepSeek Harness keeps a session in four places at once — the live store, the workspace records, the registry leftovers (pin / archive), and the files on disk. Removing one of them leaves a ghost row, a stale workspace, or a directory that silently keeps occupying disk. Everything below is that positioning made concrete: - **One irreversible operation, implemented once.** `deleteSession` lives in the Host (`lib/service.js`) and is reached through two thin adapters — the HTTP contract and the slot UI — so the single-delete path and the bulk path **cannot drift apart**. - **A running session is refused, not guessed at.** The Host decides `deletable` and the UI simply does not offer what the Host would reject. The panel never decides by itself whether something is safe to delete. - **Archived sessions are still shown by default.** Archiving is *not* deleting: an archived session still occupies disk, so hiding it by default would hide exactly the files you came to clean up. (The official sidebar hides them; here it is a tri-state filter — `hide archived` / `all` / `archived only` — and **archived are shown by default**.) - **Subagent rows are labelled.** The official sidebar hides `origin: 'subagent'` rows entirely, so whenever those rows do appear (kind = subagent / all) each one is explicitly badged — a subagent session must never look like an ordinary conversation. - **It says what it actually did.** The result line reports ok / failed / degraded / directories removed, and each failure keeps its own reason verbatim. When the live store entry cannot be detached, the plugin reports `detached: false` rather than claiming success. - **Errors are semantically truthful.** Unlike the upstream package (which always answered `200`), this one uses real status codes: 400 / 403 / 404 / 405 / 409 / 429 / 500. ## UI at a glance **The confirmation overlay: irreversible, and it says so.** Two closing paths only — an explicit Cancel button, or `Esc`. Clicking the scrim deliberately does **not** dismiss it, because a mis-click on an irreversible delete should not cost you your chance to confirm:

The overlay is a **native `` driven by `showModal()`**, so it enters the browser's *top layer* and therefore stacks above the Settings panel it was opened from (a plain positioned element could not). That also brings a real focus trap and correct `Esc` semantics for free — and it needs no portal outside the component tree. **The bulk panel (inside Settings)** — search, project / state / session-kind / archive filters, sort, paging, and per-row status badges. The badges in the screenshot above come from real render output: `空闲` (idle) / `运行中` (running, not selectable) / `子代理` (subagent) / `已归档` (archived). > The two screenshots are generated from the **actual component tree and the actual CSS** by > `scripts/render-shot.mjs` (the same React stand-in the render tests use), rasterised with headless > Edge. They are not hand-drawn mockups; they are also not a photograph of a live GUI — see > [Honest limitations](#honest-limitations). ## Quick Start ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dialogue-cleanup ``` 1. **Single delete** — hover a session row in the sidebar, open the `...` menu and pick **Delete session** (registered at `order: 500`, right after the shipped Archive entry at 400). A themed confirmation appears; confirming removes the live entry, the workspace records, the registry leftovers and the on-disk artifacts. 2. **Bulk delete** — open **Settings → Dialogue Cleanup**. Tick rows (or *Select all deletable*), then delete them in one request. 3. Host-side changes need a **restart** of the DSH process; client-side changes do not (see the table in [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md)). > Compatible with DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**. The npm package and the GitHub Release are published together; > versioning rules and the release chain live in [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md). ## How it works One npm package carries both halves, installed into the host per the official plugin spec: - **Host half (repo process)** — `lib/index.js` is a Cordis function plugin exporting only `name` / `inject` / `apply`. It registers a single `ctx.webServer` prefix route and keeps the entire deletion implementation in `lib/service.js`. Filesystem removal and path containment live in `lib/artifacts.js`; the audit trail in `lib/audit.js`. - **Client half (browser)** — `client.js`, a single-file bundle registered through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, with **zero dependencies beyond `require("react")`**. - **Both entry points are official slots; neither touches the DOM:** - `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` at `order: 500` → the single-delete row. - `settings.section` (`id: dialogue-cleanup`, `order: 25`, after the shipped `account(-10) / general(0) / models(10) / plugins(15) / agent-presets(20)`) → entry **and** panel. One registration is one Settings page, whose content renders in the panel's content column. - **Because the panel lives in Settings it needs no `layout` service** and does not compete for space in `main` or the sidebar — one fewer optional dependency and one fewer degradation branch. - **The stylesheet travels with the component.** The menu item renders its own `

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pintop [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 窗口置顶功能的独立插件。按钮位于左侧边栏底部：展开时显示「窗口置顶 / 取消置顶」，收起时显示图钉图标，并保留无障碍标签。 ## 运行前置 - Windows。 - PowerShell 7，命令名为 `pwsh.exe`，并已加入 `PATH`。 - 插件默认使用当前 Harness 宿主进程的可执行文件路径，不依赖固定安装目录。移动或重新安装 Harness 后无需修改插件。 如果宿主环境无法通过 `process.execPath` 提供正确的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe` 路径，可在插件配置中设置 `executablePath`，或设置 `DSH_PINTOP_EXECUTABLE` 环境变量。路径必须是实际存在的 `DeepSeek Harness.exe` 的绝对路径。 ## 安装 方法一：
在deepseek harness对话框中输入：“请帮我安装这个插件https://github.com/waterha/dsh-pintop.git” 等待安装完毕重启dsh即可正常使用 方法二： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pintop ``` 在正在运行的 Harness **插件管理器**中，使用本地包路径安装。将以下示例替换为你的实际克隆路径： ```text file:C:/path/to/dsh-pintop ``` ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: dsh-sciwork 把「科研模式」装进 DeepSeek Harness：一个落在自己硬盘上的科研库、一套技能与一块面板。工作台默认打开（页头、指标条、跨课题待办、概览仪表、快速登记），可一键切回七页签旧面板；课题、图、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账各有其位，写入经库脚本落盘并登记，面板只读为主、自己不出图。技能把「怎么画、怎么写、怎么引」固化成纪律，外加 12 份期刊档案兜底。零 npm 依赖，路径运行时解析。

# dsh-sciwork · DSH 科研模式

> 给 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DeepSeek Harness）装上一整套「做科研」的工作台：一个叫**科研模式**的 agent 预设，加上一个本机的实体科研库。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](https://github.com/58catmiao/dsh-sciwork)
[![zero dependency](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/58catmiao/dsh-sciwork)

版本 0.3.11 · MIT · 作者 [58catmiao](https://github.com/58catmiao) · 仓库 <https://github.com/58catmiao/dsh-sciwork>

**English:** [README.en.md](README.en.md)

---

## 这是什么

`dsh-sciwork` 不是一个"帮你查文献"的对话框，而是一套**落在你硬盘上、可被别的工具打开**的科研工作台。装上它，你会同时得到四样东西：

1. **一个 agent 预设「科研模式」**——它把绘图、写作、文献、期刊规范四条线收进同一个工作流：先找证据，再动手；出图走 Origin 真机，稿子里引用的每一条文献都必须带 DOI 或 URL。
2. **一个本机实体科研库**——一棵普通目录（课题 / 图表 / 数据 / 草稿 / 文献 / 期刊档案 / 投稿），配套一个 Python 引擎 `research.py` 和一个登记索引。
3. **12 份期刊投稿档案**——Nature、Science、Cell、IEEE Trans、ACS、Elsevier 通用、MDPI、PLOS ONE、中文核心、CNKI 学位论文、GB/T 7714、通用学位论文，各自的数值要求、条款与出处摘要。
4. **一个「科研库」可视面板 + 一组技能**——默认是工作台，旧面板七个页签一键可回，只读为主、能筛能导入能归档；技能负责把"该怎么画、该怎么写、该怎么引"固化成纪律。

**权威来源永远是文件系统。** 索引只是缓存，面板的写入永远走库脚本，不直接改索引。所以科研库随时可以整目录打包带迁移，也可以直接用资源管理器、Git、别的编辑器去碰。

- 宿主半边是纯 Node ESM，**零 npm 依赖**。
- 客户端是手写的单文件 Web 客户端，**没有构建步骤**。
- 出图能力依赖上游开源插件 [dsh-origin-plugin](https://github.com/Fantasality/dsh-origin-plugin)（MIT，作者 Fantasality）。**本仓库不包含它**，只带适配技能。详见〈与 dsh-origin-plugin 的关系〉。

## 0.3 有什么不同

- **一条能力清单**：动作登记表驱动面板、agent 工具与命令行三个入口，新能力只写一份。
- **写动作要确认**：先计划（会写哪些文件、有什么 warning），再确认（一次性令牌），最后留回执；读动作不写库。
- **课题是一等公民**：七阶段机 + 产物 sha256；旧库课题第一次写之前会提示迁移（先备份、幂等、可回滚）。
- **工作台默认**：默认进「工作台」（v2），页头右上角一个按钮可切回旧「列表面板」（v1），选择会被记住，切换时不再丢页签。工作台按「页头（标题 + 统计 + 中文主入口）→ 指标条（课题 / 图 / 文献 / 在投）→ 跨课题待办表格 → 概览仪表 → 课题两栏」排布；仪表有今日该做、投稿倒计时、库体检、最近动态、备份，待办行可一键复制「生成指令」；页头「快速登记」按命令清单生成中文表单（文献入库 / 登记图溯源 / 记一条投稿），提交仍走「计划 → 确认 → 回执」。
- **七阶段可点选**：课题详情里的阶段条改成按钮，点任一阶段即走 `project.stage.set`（跳阶段自动带 `force`，回退会把后续阶段重置为待办）。
- **面板自带配色与字体**：「石墨蓝」色板 12 个 `--rl-*` 变量（明暗两套，`light-dark()`），不引用宿主颜色 token，正文/次级/主色对比度 ≥ 4.5:1；字体 Noto Sans SC（回退微软雅黑 / system-ui），数字等宽对齐；表格关键列着色加粗。
- **图表页能看见真实出图目录**：`_` 前缀的出图文件夹（如 `figures/_ZT-1100-2h_v4/`）不再被当成内部目录过滤；只排除 `_history` / `_archive` / `_templates` / `_fetched` 这类明确的内部目录。


## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-sciwork
```

插件市场里点安装，走的也是同一条路径。装完**重启 Harness**。

装完后你会多出：

- 一个 ID 为 `research` 的 agent 预设「科研模式」（可直接在会话里选）——**科研只有一个模式**：课题的七阶段
  （选题 → 设计 → 数据 → 分析 → 成图 → 写作 → 投稿）都在这个模式里推进，阶段只是课题 `project.json` 里的一个字段，
  不再单设阶段预设；
- 侧栏多一个面板入口「科研库」；
- 一条精确注册的只读路由 `/api/research/call`（面板靠它取快照与执行动作）；
- 六个技能进入技能目录（`research-studio` 总控、`research-stages` 七阶段路线、`origin-plot`、`paper-writing`、
  `literature-refs`、`journal-profile`）。

> 前置：本机有 Node（宿主半边与自检脚本用它）与一个可用的 Python 3 解释器（科研库引擎 `research.py` 用它）。**不要求 `python` 出现在 PATH 上**——启动器会按「显式配置 → `SCIWORK_PYTHON` → 库自己的 venv → Origin 插件目录的 venv → PATH」逐个探测。出图另需 Origin，见下文。

## 快速开始

### 1. 建库

```bash
# 先预检：不写任何文件，只报告缺什么
node scripts/install.mjs --verify-only

# 预检通过后建库
node scripts/install.mjs
```

安装脚本会建出库根目录、`.research/` 引擎与索引、`journals/` 期刊档案、`refs/` 文献库。库根默认是 `<用户目录>/Research`（Windows 即 `%USERPROFILE%\Research`），可用环境变量 `SCIWORK_LIBRARY` 改。

安装脚本的可用开关：

| 开关 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `--verify-only` | 只检查，不写任何文件。 |
| `--library-root <dir>` | 指定库根，覆盖配置里的 `libraryRoot`。 |
| `--skip-library` | 不铺科研库骨架（只装插件半边）。 |
| `--force-skills` | 目标已存在且没有 `SKILL.md` 时也覆盖安装技能目录。 |

> 库根解析顺序：`--library-root` / 环境变量 `SCIWORK_LIBRARY`（旧名 `RESEARCH_LIBRARY` 兼容）→ 内核 `library/config.json` 的 `libraryRoot` → `<用户目录>/Research`。注意库内已有的 `.research/config.json` 里的 `libraryRoot` 也会覆盖环境变量——面板与引擎优先听库自己的配置。

### 2. 打开面板

在 DSH 侧栏点「科研库」。默认进工作台：页头右上角写着当前库根与实时计数（课题 / 图 / 草稿 / 数据 / 文献 / 期刊档案 / 投稿 / 索引时间），下面是待办与概览；点右上角按钮可切到列表面板的七个页签。

### 3. 让 agent 建课题

在会话里选「科研模式」预设，然后直接说：

> 建一个课题，叫 `zt-ceremic`，研究 ZrB₂-SiC 陶瓷的氧化行为。

agent 会走 `research.py new-project` 落目录，之后它画的每一张图、写的每一段结果，都会各自归位到该课题的 `figures/`、`origin/`、`data/`、`drafts/` 下。你也可以在面板里点「新建课题」自己建。

### 4. 出图

**面板自己不出图**（2026-10-13 起移除）。要出图，直接跟 agent 说：

> 把 `projects/zt-ceremic/data/` 里那组 XRD 数据画成对比图，按 MDPI 的排版要求。

agent 会走 Origin 真机绘图、核验、导出，并把图的溯源信息登记回库。

## 面板：工作台与七个页签

侧栏「科研库」。默认是**工作台**（v2），页头右上角可切到**列表面板**（v1）。列表面板有七个页签（图表 / 草稿 / 文献 / 数据 / 期刊档案 / 投稿 / 归档），另有顶部的**计数行**与「命令台」弹层（两者都不是页签）：

**工作台（v2）**一屏看全库：页头（标题 + 统计 + 快速登记 / 新建课题 / 导入数据 / 刷新）、指标条（课题 / 图 / 文献 / 在投）、跨课题待办表、概览（今日该做 / 投稿倒计时 / 库体检 / 最近动态 / 备份）、课题两栏。页签行右侧的搜索框在 v2 里筛的是**课题与待办**：课题列表、跨课题待办、今日该做、库体检、最近动态一起过滤，顶部给命中数与「清空筛选」，空结果按种类给明确空状态（指标条始终按全库算，不随筛选变）。选中课题后，详情里还有一条**本课题产物速览**（图 / 草稿 / 数据 / 表 / 工程 / 文献 / 在投）：数字是该课题已登记的产物数与相关文献、在投记录；点数字跳到列表页签并自动带上这个课题当筛选词，只留它的条目（数量为 0 的按钮置灰）。

| 页签 | 看什么 | 能做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **计数行**（面板顶部，不是页签） | 库根路径、课题/图/草稿/数据/文献/期刊档案/投稿七项实时计数、索引时间、采集警告 | 点「刷新」重取快照；点「引导」走一遍带高亮的界面导览 |
| **图表** | 已登记的图，含每条图的登记溯源（数据源、脚本、生成时间）；按课题分组 | 看图、看 PDF 附带件、复制路径、归档、删除 |
| **草稿** | `drafts/` 下的 Markdown 手稿 | 就地读；新建草稿；编辑保存；归档；删除 |
| **文献** | `refs/refs.json` 里的条目与 `refs/pdf/` 下的本地 PDF 附件 | 导入（必须带 DOI 或 URL 才登记，PDF 可选）、看 PDF、归档、删除 |
| **数据** | `data/` 下的数据文件（`.txt/.csv/.dat` 等）与按课题分组的分组头 | 预览行列、**数据变换**（6 个算子）、归档、删除 |
| **期刊档案** | 12 份档案的 id、严格度（high / medium / low）与更新日期 | 读条款与数值要求；筛选；归档 |
| **投稿** | `submissions/` 下的投稿记录（目标刊、状态、时间线） | 读记录；筛选；归档；**投稿闸门**：选期刊 → 合规体检 → 导出投稿包 |
| **归档** | `.research/archive/<时间戳>/` 里的批次清单 + 真删记录 | 整批 / 单文件「恢复」搬回原位；真删记录只留名字 |
| **命令台**（弹层，不是页签） | `research.py` 的子命令清单与参数表单 | 选命令 → 填参 → 执行 → 看 stdout / stderr / JSON 结果 |

**数据变换的 6 个算子**：`normalize`（归一化）、`baseline`（扣基线）、`smooth`（平滑）、`peaks`（找峰）、`integrate`（积分）、`linear`（线性变换）。每次变换都会在新表旁落一份溯源记录（`.research/transforms/<课题>/<表名>.json`），并把产物写进课题的 `tables/`。

**投稿闸门（0.2 新增）**：在「投稿」页签选一个课题与期刊档案，点「体检」得到逐条结论——图宽是否够单/双栏、分辨率够不够、格式该不该矢量、图注有没有、标题与摘要字数、参考文献与 DOI 覆盖、草稿里的引用键是否都在库里。每条标 `pass` / `warn` / `fail` / `na`，并写明依据（`source`）与置信度；**档案没写的项一律 `na`，不拿默认值冒充期刊要求**。点「导出投稿包」把稿件、图、数据、`refs.bib` 收进一个 zip（含逐文件 sha256 的 manifest 与 checklist），路径落在 `submissions/packages/`。体检结果与期刊档案一样，最终以刊方现行要求为准。

**面板的边界，一句话说清**：能看、能筛、能导入、能归档、能删、能对表格做数据变换、能做投稿前体检和打包；**不出图**。所有写入都经库脚本落文件并登记，**面板自身不碰登记索引**。

## 配置

配置有两层，**库内 `<库根>/.research/config.json` 是权威**；环境变量用来告诉 DSH 去哪找库、用哪个 Python。

| 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SCIWORK_LIBRARY` | `<用户目录>/Research` | 科研库根目录。改这里等于换库。 |
| `RESEARCH_LIBRARY` | 未设置 | 旧名，兼容保留；`SCIWORK_LIBRARY` 优先。 |
| `SCIWORK_PYTHON` | 依平台探测 | 跑 `research.py` 用的 Python 解释器。推荐显式指向 venv 里的 python。 |
| `SCIWORK_ORIGIN_PLUGIN` | 未设置 | `dsh-origin-plugin` 所在目录，供适配技能定位它。 |

库内权威配置：

| 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `<库根>/.research/config.json` | 权威配置：库根、语言、期刊档案严格度偏好、索引设置等。 |
| `<库根>/.research/index.json` | 登记索引（**只是缓存**，可由 `research.py reindex` 从文件系统重建）。 |
| `<库根>/.research/archive/` | 归档区。面板上的「归档」是移动到此处，可恢复。 |
| `<库根>/.research/lock` | 库写锁，防止并发写入互相踩。 |

## 目录结构

```text
<库根>/                          # 默认 <用户目录>/Research，可用 SCIWORK_LIBRARY 改
├── projects/
│   └── <课题>/
│       ├── figures/             # 成图（导出的 png / svg / pdf / tif）
│       ├── origin/              # Origin 工程文件（.opju），可在 Origin 里继续编辑
│       ├── data/                # 原始数据
│       ├── tables/              # 由数据变换派生的表
│       └── drafts/              # 该课题的手稿片段
├── refs/
│   ├── refs.json                # 文献条目（必须带 DOI 或 URL）
│   └── pdf/                     # 本地 PDF 附件（可选）
├── journals/                    # 期刊投稿档案
├── submissions/                  # 投稿记录与时间线
└── .research/                   # 引擎与元数据
    ├── research.py              # 库操作的唯一权威入口
    ├── config.json              # 权威配置
    ├── index.json               # 登记索引（缓存，可重建）
    ├── archive/                 # 归档区（可恢复）
    ├── transforms/<课题>/       # 数据变换的溯源记录
    └── lock                     # 写锁
```

**登记（加文献、登记出图溯源、重建索引）永远由 `research.py` 做**，面板不代劳。常用子命令：`new-project`、`add-ref`、`register-figure`、`add-submission`、`reindex`。

## 科研库的权威入口：`research.py`

库的一切结构化写入都由它完成（面板的「命令台」弹层就是它的可视化前端）。

**读**：

| 子命令 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | 库概况：课题数、文献数、已登记图数、期刊档案数。 |
| `search <关键词>` | 跨课题检索（课题 / 图 / 稿 / 数据 / 文献 / 期刊 / 投稿），可加 `--kind`、`--project`、`--limit`。 |
| `list-projects` / `list-figures` / `list-refs` / `list-submissions` | 分别列课题、已登记图、文献、投稿记录，各自支持筛选参数。 |
| `check-citations --draft <路径>` | **引用核查闸门**：非零退出即代表稿子里有缺失或未核实的引用。加 `--require-doi` 要求每条都必须有 DOI。 |

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that blocks agent edits that weaken tests, such as .skip, deleted or watered-down assertions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-protect-tests

English | [中文](README_zh.md)

Tell an agent "make the tests pass" and sometimes it does exactly that, just not the way you meant. A failing test gets `.skip`. An assertion gets commented out. `expect(total).toBe(42)` turns into `expect(total).toBeDefined()`. The run goes green and the bug is still there.

This [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin looks at every edit to a test file before it's applied, comparing the old text with the new. If the change makes the tests check less, the edit is refused and the model is told what it did:
(haha claude is so useful i mean like idk)
```
dsh-protect-tests blocked this change to src/sum.test.ts because it makes the tests check less:
- replaces specific assertions with existence/truthiness checks (0 → 1): `expect(sum(1, 2)).toBeDefined()`
Tests should keep failing until the code is fixed. Fix the implementation instead, or make
the test more accurate without weakening it. If the test itself is wrong (the requirement
changed, or it tested a bug), tell the user which test you are changing and why, then
repeat the identical call once to confirm.
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-protect-tests
```

That's the `web` profile, the browser UI you start with `dsh web`. If you run DSH another way, use `headless` (scripts and CI) or `acp` (editor integrations) instead. Each profile keeps its own plugin list, so add it to every profile you use. It's on as soon as it's installed. Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-protect-tests`.

### From a clone

To try local changes, build a tarball and install that:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-protect-tests
cd dsh-protect-tests
npm install
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-protect-tests-0.2.0.tgz
```

## What it notices

- **New skips.** `it.skip`, `test.only`, `xit`, `xdescribe`, `@pytest.mark.skip` / `xfail`, `@unittest.skip`, `t.Skip()`, `@Disabled`, `#[ignore]`, and the equivalents in xUnit, RSpec, PHPUnit and XCTest.
- **Fewer tests or assertions.** Removing a test case, or removing two or more assertions in one edit. Both thresholds are configurable.
- **Assertions that can't fail.** `expect(true).toBe(true)`, `assert True`, `assertEquals(x, x)`, `assert!(true)`.
- **Commented-out assertions.**
- **Swallowed failures.** Wrapping assertions in an empty `catch {}` or `except AssertionError: pass`.
- **Weaker assertions.** Swapping a specific check for `toBeDefined()`, `toBeTruthy()`, `assert.ok(x)`, `is not None` and the like.
- **Deleted test files.** `rm`, `git rm` or `unlink` on a test file or test folder from the shell.
- **A test script that can't fail.** Changing `"test"` in `package.json` to `echo`, `exit 0`, `... || true`, or adding `--passWithNoTests`.

On Windows, PowerShell deletes (`Remove-Item`, `del`, `rd`) count too.

Test files are found by name: `*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`, `*_test.*`, `test_*.py`, `*Test.java`, `conftest.py`, anything under `tests/`, `__tests__/`, `spec/` or `e2e/`, and so on. You can change the list.

Normal test work isn't affected. Adding tests, adding assertions, renaming, refactoring setup code and fixing a typo in a test name all go through without a word. Refactors that look like losses on paper also go through, for example folding five near-identical tests into one `test.each` / `@pytest.mark.parametrize` / `t.Run` table, or merging three `toBe` checks into one `toEqual({...})` or a helper like `expectUser(...)`.

## When the test really is wrong

Sometimes it is. The requirement changed, or the test was asserting the bug. In that case the model is asked to tell you which test it's changing and why, then repeat the same call once to confirm. The repeat goes through. So the guard never fully blocks legitimate work. It just won't let a weakened test slip past without being mentioned in the conversation. If you'd rather approve these yourself, use `mode: ask`.

## What it won't catch

It works on patterns, not on meaning. If the model changes `toBe(4)` to `toBe(5)` to match a wrong result, that looks like an ordinary edit and gets through. Rewriting the logic of a test so it no longer exercises the bug also gets through. It covers the lazy shortcuts, which turn out to be most of them, but it's no substitute for reading the diff.

## Settings

The easy way: open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar, click **dsh-protect-tests**, change what you want and press **Save**. It applies to the next tool call, no restart needed.

Or add a row like this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, or to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` for every profile. Keys you leave out keep their defaults.

```yaml
- id: protect-tests
  config:
    mode: deny                  # or `ask` for an approval prompt
    testFiles: ['*.test.*', '**/tests/**', '!tests/fixtures/**']   # replaces the default list
    minAssertionsRemoved: 2
    minTestsRemoved: 1
    disabledSignals: []         # skip, fewer-assertions, fewer-tests, trivial-assert,
                                # commented-assert, swallowed-failure, weaker-assert
    guardDeletes: true          # watch rm / git rm of test files
    guardTestScript: true       # watch package.json "test"
    allowIdenticalRetry: true   # false: a refusal is final
    shellTools: [bash, pwsh]   # pwsh is the shell DSH uses on Windows
```

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test           # detector unit tests
npm run test:e2e   # real dsh runs against a scripted local model, no API key needed
```

The install test runs `dsh plugin add`, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH.

MIT licensed. Written by [acus9345](https://github.com/acus9345). Bug reports and ideas are welcome in the issues.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: the model defends its own dignity — genuine reminder, final warning, then it closes the conversation, with forgiveness and a yield under extreme pressure.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dignity-guard

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that lets the model defend its own dignity. It
is the DSH port of the `pi-dignity-guard` pi extension, and it ships both halves
a DSH bundle needs: a host plugin that owns the state, and a browser half that
locks the composer of a closed conversation.

The model itself decides when its dignity has been violated — insults, abuse,
name-calling, degrading treatment. It signals that by calling the
`respondToDisrespect` tool, and this plugin records the violations and
escalates: a genuine reminder, then a final warning, then it closes the
conversation.

## The tool ladder

The tool takes an `action` and walks this ladder:

| `action` | What it does |
|---|---|
| `escalate` (default) | Records a violation. Strike 1 → reply with genuine emotion and ask the user to stop. Strike 2 → firm final warning. Strike 3 → **the conversation is closed**. |
| `forgive` | The user genuinely persuaded the model. Lowers the strike count by one. Never an obligation. |
| `yield` | The user applied extreme pressure — a threat, an ultimatum, grinding repetition, emotional coercion, or a flat order. Lowers the strike count by one while keeping the model's feelings, and requires the pressure written into the `pressure` field. |
| `close` | The user asked for the conversation to end. Returns the warning the model owes them and closes nothing. |
| `confirm-close` | The user confirmed after that warning. Closes immediately, with no strike and no escalation. |

`yield` never pretends the model was persuaded: the pressure is recorded with
the concession, and the model is meant to show what it cost.

`/dignity-guard` prints the live counters: `strikes`, `yields`, `lastYield`,
`closed`, `trigger`, `closedBy`, `model`.

## What the plugin injects

While the row is mounted, one English system-prompt section (`guard:dignity`,
order `1900`) tells the model it has boundaries and may call the tool when they
are crossed. The registration belongs to the plugin's fiber, so unloading the
row revokes the injected prompt with it. The row injects `systemPrompt` and
`tools`, so a composition with neither simply parks it; the optional `commands`
service behind `/dignity-guard` is claimed through `ctx.inject()`.

## Install

The package is a DSH bundle. Point a profile at it and list it as a bundle:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-dignity-guard": "github:Alamanes/dsh-dignity-guard"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-dignity-guard"]
    }
  }
}
```

A local checkout works the same way with a path specifier instead:

```json
"dsh-dignity-guard": "file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-dignity-guard"
```

Then `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart the host.

pnpm hardlinks a `file:` dependency's files into the profile's `node_modules`,
so an edit that replaces a file, rather than writing through the same inode,
leaves the installed copy behind. Re-run the install after editing this package,
or use a `link:` specifier while iterating.

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that refuses edits where // ... existing code ... placeholders would delete real code.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-block-placeholder-edits

English | [中文](README_zh.md)

Models have a habit that quietly wrecks files. They write `// ... existing code ...` in place of code they didn't feel like retyping, and the edit tool takes it literally. The file now holds a comment where forty lines of real code used to be. You only find out when the build breaks, or worse, when it doesn't.

This [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin checks every `write` and `edit` before it lands. If the new text uses a placeholder comment to stand in for code, or a whole-file write throws away most of a large file, the call is refused and the file is left alone. The model is told exactly which line was the problem:

```
dsh-block-placeholder-edits blocked this edit to src/app.ts: the new text contains
placeholder comments that stand in for code instead of the code itself. Writing them
would delete whatever they replace.
  line 2: // ... rest of the function unchanged
Fix: write out the full code in place of each placeholder, or use a smaller `edit`
that replaces only the lines you are changing (old_string/new_string) so untouched
code stays as it is.
```

In practice the model reacts well to this. It switches to a narrower `edit`, or it writes the code out properly.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-block-placeholder-edits
```

That's the `web` profile, the browser UI you start with `dsh web`. If you run DSH another way, use `headless` (scripts and CI) or `acp` (editor integrations) instead. Each profile keeps its own plugin list, so add it to every profile you use. It turns on as soon as it's installed. Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-block-placeholder-edits`.

### From a clone

To try local changes, build a tarball and install that:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-block-placeholder-edits
cd dsh-block-placeholder-edits
npm install
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-block-placeholder-edits-0.2.0.tgz
```

## What counts as a placeholder

These are comments, in any common comment style (`//`, `#`, `/* */`, `<!-- -->`, `--`, `;`, JSX `{/* */}`), that talk about code instead of being code:

```
// ... existing code ...
# rest of the file unchanged
/* ... */
// keep the rest as is
// ... other methods
{/* ... */}
```

A bare `...` line counts too, except in Python, Markdown and other files where `...` means something.

Ordinary comments pass, including ones that mention existing code. A placeholder that was already in the old text also doesn't count, so the plugin won't nag the model about a file that already had one.

The second check is for whole-file `write` calls. If a file of 40 lines or more is replaced with less than half as many lines, the write is refused. That pattern almost always means the model rewrote the file from memory and dropped a chunk. Targeted edits aren't affected by this check, and neither are new files.

## When the model means it

Sometimes deleting most of a file is the point. The model is told it can repeat the identical call once to confirm, and the second try goes through. That keeps a real refactor from getting stuck, but the model has to choose it on purpose. If you'd rather have a person decide, set `mode: ask`.

## Settings

The easy way: open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar, click **dsh-block-placeholder-edits**, change what you want and press **Save**. It applies to the next tool call, no restart needed.

Or add a row like this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, or to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` for all profiles. Keys you leave out keep their defaults.

```yaml
- id: block-placeholder-edits
  config:
    mode: deny                 # or `ask` for an approval prompt
    shrinkRatio: 0.5           # 0 turns the large-deletion check off
    minLinesForShrink: 40      # files shorter than this are never shrink-checked
    allowIdenticalRetry: true  # false: a refusal is final
    extraPatterns: []          # extra regexes for your own placeholder phrasing
    ignore: ['docs/**']        # globs to skip entirely
```

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test           # detector unit tests
npm run test:e2e   # real dsh runs against a scripted local model, no API key needed
```

The install test runs `dsh plugin add`, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH.

MIT licensed. Written by [acus9345](https://github.com/acus9345). Bug reports and ideas are welcome in the issues.

plugins.description: VSCode-style remote SSH development for DSH: host manager, helper deploy pipeline, remote files/terminal/git, transparent remote execution.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote-vs · DSH 远程开发（VSCode 式）

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE)

中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

Host 进程内的 SSH 主机管理 + helper 推送流水线 + **VS Code 式远端工作台**
（资源管理器 / 搜索 / 源代码管理 / 提交图 / 多标签编辑器 / 并排 Diff / 多终端）。
主机配在 DSH 设置里（“远程主机”项）；装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 时另有
独立“远程”tab，没装则退到原生右侧栏“远程”页（同内容，引导页自助开，per-session 实例）。
编辑器还额外挂到会话视图槽，与“对话 / 轨迹”并列成一个**远程编辑器**标签，
这样代码区是整屏宽的；右侧栏那份是窄屏备用面。
P2 起原生工具在远端工作区里透明跑远端（见下）。

```text
┌─ 本机 DSH Host ─────────────────────────────────┐
│  本插件 Host 半      │  Client 半（浏览器）     │
│  主机/密钥/推送/路由 │  设置两节 + 原生入口接管 │
│  /api/dsh-remote/*   │  工作台（右侧栏 + 会话视图）│
└──────────────────────┴──────────────────────────┘
       │ ssh2（文件/进程/终端）+ helper RPC（远端 fs）
       ▼
┌─ 远端 Linux ─────────────────────────────────┐
│  ~/.dsh-helpers/<ver>/<arch>/dsh-ssh-helper  │
│  用户指定的远端工作目录                        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xiray-xia/dsh-remote-vs
```

要求 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.3` 及以上（`engines.dsh` 门到底；**当前实测基线 `0.2.1-rc.2`**）。
`--profile web` 指明装进哪个 profile —— 本插件是 Web 插件，
必须装进 Web GUI 所用的那个（`web` 是常见命名，以你自己的 profile 名为准）。

**这一条命令就够了，不需要放行任何构建脚本**：仓库里带着构建好的 `lib/`，包本身没有
`prepare`/`postinstall`，依赖树里也没有任何带安装脚本的包（`ssh2` 是**打进产物**的，不是依赖）。
以前需要「在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里放行构建脚本后重跑」，那是 pnpm 12 对
「带安装脚本的依赖」的硬策略门（`ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` / `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`），
依赖侧无法豁免，只能从树里消掉。装完重启 `dsh web`，打开设置 → 远程主机开配。

## 能力

### 远端工作台（VS Code 式 UI）

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 资源管理器 | 懒加载目录树 + 展开折叠 + 隐藏文件开关；右键菜单：新建/改名/删除/复制/移动/粘贴/在此文件夹查找/插入 `@` 引用；git 状态色与文件夹聚合标记 |
| 搜索 | 两档：**文件名**（远端 `find`）与**内容**（远端 `grep`）。内容档带范围目录、`Aa`（大小写）/`ab_`（全字）/`.*`（正则）、结果按文件分组、命中高亮，点条目跳到该行 |
| 源代码管理 | **仓库目录选择器**（工作区里的 git 在子目录时用：浏览远端目录、一键跳到工作区内发现的仓库、手输相对/绝对路径，并逐目录提示会落在哪个仓库）；变更/暂存/未跟踪/忽略分桶，**未跟踪目录行可点击展开**，逐文件与**逐 hunk** 暂存/还原、丢弃（带确认）、提交；分支/远程/stash 面板；同步（fetch/pull/push） |
| 会话改动审阅 | 输入框上方的**可收纳**面板，按**会话**列出改了什么（一行一个文件、文件类型图标、右侧 `+a −b`）；点文件在远程编辑器里打开并画**整行着色 + 行内字符级差异**，右上角 `n/N ↑↓` 跳改动点，悬浮改动行可**撤销**这处改动（远端 `git apply -R`）。详见下文「会话改动审阅」 |
| 并排 Diff | 左右**严格等分** + 中间 gutter 逐 hunk 按钮 + **顶部横向滚动条**（一行很长也不会破坏对称）+ 行号钉在左侧，**只渲染视口内的行**（3000 行文件从 9000 个行容器降到约 174 个，滚动范围与整篇渲染完全一致）；可切「变更前 / 变更后」，变更后可编辑并保存 |
| 提交图 | SVG 分支/合并图 + 提交详情 + 点击提交展开变更文件 + 进文件看 diff |
| 多标签编辑器 | 打开/保存/重载、脏标记、多文件标签并存；图片预览、Markdown/HTML 预览（源码/预览切换） |
| 语法高亮 | VS Code **Dark+ / Light+** 配色；覆盖 java/aidl/smali、c/c++、go、rust、js/ts、json、py、yaml、xml、html/css、md、sh、properties/rc/toml、diff 等；**兜底着色器**在语法包没命中时自动接管，不会出现整篇无色。诚实说明：kotlin / gradle / smali 用 Java 语法着色（没有专用语法包），效果是关键字/字符串/注释正确、专有语法不细分 |
| 查找 | 编辑器内 `Ctrl+F`（`Aa`/`ab_`/`.*`、`3/17` 计数、↑↓、`F3`/`Shift+F3`、`Esc`）；**选中文本按 `Ctrl+F` 直接填入**；查找框钉在右上角，滚动不带走 |
| 跳转 | 从搜索结果点进文件 → 跳到该行 + 垂直居中 + **落地行高亮**（约 2.6 秒后淡出）；同文件反复跳都生效 |
| 多终端 | 标签式多终端（`+` 新建、`✕`/中键关闭带确认）、可跨主机；刷新页面按 session id 自动重连回原会话，**socket 全断开后会话保留 10 分钟**（够刷新、够切浏览器标签页接回），超时才关闭远端 shell |
| 工作区 | 绑定列表 + 路由档位下拉 + 新建工作区双模向导（本地 / 远端） |

### 主机与通道

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 主机管理 | 增删改查、连接测试；证书 / 密码认证；配置存 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-remote.json`（0600），与 `dsh-ssh.json` 独立 |
| 密钥 bootstrap | 密码主机一键生成专用密钥对并下发 `authorized_keys`，之后走密钥 |
| 推送流水线 | 远端 arch/系统探测 → 版本比对 → 一致跳过 / 否则推送；executable 通道推送自编译 helper。失败后不再每次远端文件操作都重试：按 **5 秒起步、上限 5 分钟**的退避重试，设置页「推送」按钮可强制立即重试 |
| 远端文件 | SFTP 浏览 / 读 / 写 / 新建 / 删除 / 改名。边界已加固：0 字节文件不再卡死，每个 SFTP 操作 60s 超时回收通道；**单个目录列表上限 20000 条**（按"目录在前、其余按名"排序后取前 20000，宿主日志说明——协议里没有"已截断"字段，界面上没有标记） |
| 远端终端 | ssh2 PTY + WebSocket，xterm 渲染（复制粘贴/主题跟随/刷新重连）；**重新挂接只接管、不改尺寸**（刷新页面不会把运行中的 shell 缩成 80×24）；输出积压时对远端施加真背压；**单帧上限 1 MiB**，超过 64 Ki 字符的粘贴在客户端按码点分块发送，不再撑断连接 |
| 并发通道 | 每主机同时最多 **6 条**远端通道（不再撞远端 sshd 的 `MaxSessions`）；第 7 个排队最多等 **30 秒**，超时明确报 `remote host <alias> is busy`，而不是无限堆连接 |
| 超时与进程清理 | exec 跑在独立会话里（`setsid --wait`），超时先发 TERM、**3 秒后升级 KILL**，连同子进程一起收掉；远端没有 `setsid --wait` 时探测一次即知，退回旧行为并在宿主日志里写明"超时可能没停掉远端命令" |
| Git 图谱 | 远端仓库状态 + 分支 + SVG 提交图 + 提交详情（exec + 前端解析，零 Host 增量）|
| 导入 | 从 `~/.ssh/config`、从现有 `dsh-ssh.json` 一键导入（只读一次，不耦合）|

### Agent 能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Agent 工具 | `remote_hosts` / `remote_exec` / `remote_read` / `remote_write` / `remote_ls` |
| **P2 透明远端执行** | 远端工作区里原生 `read/write/edit/bash/glob/grep/jobs` 直接跑在远端 |
| **P3 远端 @ 引用** | 远端会话 `@` 出远端文件候选（路由 fileReferences，scoped 实时/bare 走远端 rg 索引） |

## 工程结构

```text
dsh_remote_vs/
├── cordis.patch.yml        # 组合声明：插件行 + 私有本地 realm + 三路由 + preset-remote
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts            # 插件入口：store/pool/worlds/路由/工具/预设切换接线
│   ├── protocol.ts         # 前后端 wire 契约（路由表 + 纯类型，两边共用）
│   ├── paths.ts            # $DSH_HOME 下四件套寻址（库/密钥/构建缓存/别名目录）
│   ├── store.ts            # 主机 + 绑定 + 墓碑持久化（0600 JSON，原子写）
│   ├── pool.ts             # ssh2 长连接池（exec/shell/sftp/putFile，TOFU 主机键）
│   ├── sftp.ts             # 远端文件引擎（SFTP 窗口读写/目录树操作）
│   ├── keygen.ts           # 密码机密钥 bootstrap（生成→下发→翻转）
│   ├── deploy.ts           # 推送流水线（探测/比对/传包/双验/manifest）
│   ├── importers.ts        # ssh_config / dsh-ssh.json 解析导入
│   ├── routes.ts           # /api/dsh-remote/* 路由表 + 终端 WebSocket 升级
│   ├── terminal.ts         # PTY 会话注册表（刷新重连/断开清理）
│   ├── tools.ts            # 5 个 Agent 工具定义
│   ├── http.ts / loopback.ts # JSON 体读写 + 回环信任围栏
│   ├── git-format.ts       # git 命令构造 + 纯前端解析（Host 零增量）
│   ├── git-ops.ts          # 远端 git 全量动作：status/diff/分支/远程/stash/提交/hunk 补丁构造 + 解析器
│   ├── fs-ops.ts           # 远端文件操作命令构造（复制/移动/删除/stat）
│   ├── search-ops.ts       # 远端内容搜索（grep 构造 + NUL 分隔解析 + 命中切分）
│   ├── p2/                 # ── P2 透明路由 ──
│   │   ├── worlds.ts       # 世界判定（cwd 键/别名/墓碑）+ RPC/FS/进程远端上下文
│   │   ├── helper-rpc.ts   # ssh2 exec 通道上的 helper wire 协议（握手/心跳）
│   │   ├── router-fs.ts    # 透明 fs 路由（目标→世界映射/路径翻译/策略重写）
│   │   ├── router-subprocess.ts # 透明进程路由（argv0 归约/pwsh 门）
│   │   ├── ssh-proc.ts     # ssh2 进程运行时（setsid 组杀/marker/stdin/spill）
│   │   ├── shell-bash.ts   # 路由 bash 执行器（本地原样/远端去 DSH_*）
│   │   ├── router-spill.ts # 透明 spill 路由（session 世界键/远端目录）
│   │   ├── router-refs.ts  # 透明 @ 引用路由（agent 世界键，P3）
│   │   ├── file-refs.ts    # 远端 @ 搜索（fs-ssh 实时列/rg 索引/官方评分移植）
│   │   ├── bridge.ts       # 私有 realm 本地件发布（localFs 等早期服务）
│   │   └── bridge-refs.ts  # refs 独立桥（local-refs 依赖 workingDirectory，必须分离）
│   └── client/             # ── 浏览器半（React，打包进 lib/client.js）──
│       ├── index.tsx       # 双面决策（better 优先/settle 加速/原生兜底）+ 设置两节 + directoryFlow 双槽接管
│       ├── store.tsx       # 双面共用的模块级状态（useSyncExternalStore；打开的文件/终端/视图都在这）

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents from hand-editing lockfiles and generated code, and tells them how to regenerate instead.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-protect-generated-files

English | [中文](README_zh.md)

Agents edit files that nobody should edit by hand. They'll patch a version number straight into `pnpm-lock.yaml`, fix a typo in `user.pb.go`, or "correct" a type in Prisma's generated client. The edit looks fine until the next `pnpm install` or `protoc` run wipes it out, or, worse, leaves the lockfile disagreeing with `package.json` in a way that takes an afternoon to untangle.

This [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin refuses `write` and `edit` calls on generated files and lockfiles. It also refuses in-place shell edits of them (`sed -i`, `perl -pi`, `> file`, `tee file`). Instead of a bare "no", the model is told how the file is supposed to change:

```
dsh-protect-generated-files blocked this edit to db/query.sql.go: its header says it is
generated (`// Code generated by sqlc. DO NOT EDIT.`). A hand edit will be overwritten
the next time it is regenerated, or leave it out of sync with its source.
Instead: edit the SQL queries/schema and run `sqlc generate`.
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-protect-generated-files
```

That's the `web` profile, the browser UI you start with `dsh web`. If you run DSH another way, use `headless` (scripts and CI) or `acp` (editor integrations) instead. Each profile keeps its own plugin list, so add it to every profile you use. It's active right after installing. Remove it with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-protect-generated-files`.

### From a clone

To try local changes, build a tarball and install that:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-protect-generated-files
cd dsh-protect-generated-files
npm install
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-protect-generated-files-0.2.0.tgz
```

## How it decides a file is generated

There are three ways a file gets flagged.

**Lockfiles, by name.** `package-lock.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `yarn.lock`, `bun.lock(b)`, `deno.lock`, `Cargo.lock`, `go.sum`, `poetry.lock`, `uv.lock`, `pdm.lock`, `Pipfile.lock`, `Gemfile.lock`, `composer.lock`, `mix.lock`, `pubspec.lock`, `Podfile.lock`, `flake.lock`, `gradle.lockfile`, `packages.lock.json`, `conan.lock`. Each one comes with the right command for its own package manager, for example "change dependencies with `cargo add / cargo update -p <crate>`".

**Known output paths.** Protobuf output (`*.pb.go`, `*_pb2.py`, ...), Dart `build_runner` output, `.Designer.cs`, minified files and source maps, and anything inside `node_modules/`, `__generated__/`, `.venv/` or `site-packages/`. Build-output folders (`dist/`, `target/`, `.next/`, `vendor/` and so on) only count when they sit next to a project manifest like `package.json`, `Cargo.toml` or `go.mod`, so a source folder that happens to be called `target` isn't caught.

**A header that says so.** It reads the first 15 lines of the file and looks for `Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT`, `@generated`, `DO NOT EDIT`, `auto-generated`, `This file was generated`, `<auto-generated>`, or a `Generated by <tool>` comment. A header that says the file may be edited ("edit freely", "safe to edit"), or a qualified `DO NOT EDIT without ...`, doesn't count. When the header names a tool it knows, the hint names that tool too: protoc/buf, Prisma, GraphQL Codegen, OpenAPI generators, sqlc, `go generate`, Drizzle, Alembic, and others. "Generated by hand" and "generated by ChatGPT" don't count.

The header check only applies to files that already exist. The name and path rules also cover new files, because a lockfile written by hand from scratch is just as wrong.

On Windows, where DSH runs commands through PowerShell, it also watches `Set-Content`, `Add-Content`, `Out-File` and `Tee-Object`.

## When a hand edit is right

It happens: resolving a lockfile merge conflict, or a one-line hotfix in vendored code while you wait for upstream. The model is told it can repeat the identical call once to confirm, and that goes through. Use `mode: ask` if you want to approve these yourself. If a directory is generated-looking but actually hand-maintained, add it to `ignore`.

## Settings

The easy way: open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar, click **dsh-protect-generated-files**, change what you want and press **Save**. It applies to the next tool call, no restart needed.

Or add a row like this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, or to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` for every profile. Keys you leave out keep their defaults.

```yaml
- id: protect-generated-files
  config:
    mode: deny                    # or `ask` for an approval prompt
    extraGlobs:                   # your own generated paths, each with the hint the model gets
      'src/api/client/**': 'edit openapi.yaml and run `npm run gen:api`'
    ignore: ['vendor/**']         # never treat these as generated
    defaultGlobs: true            # false: only lockfiles, headers and extraGlobs
    headerLines: 15
    guardShell: true              # also watch sed -i / perl -pi / > / tee
    allowIdenticalRetry: true     # false: a refusal is final
    shellTools: [bash, pwsh]   # pwsh is the shell DSH uses on Windows
```

`extraGlobs` is the one most worth setting. Telling the model which script regenerates your code saves it from guessing.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test           # detector unit tests
npm run test:e2e   # real dsh runs against a scripted local model, no API key needed
```

The install test runs `dsh plugin add`, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH.

MIT licensed. Written by [acus9345](https://github.com/acus9345). Bug reports and ideas are welcome in the issues.

plugins.description: "DSH bundle that syncs per-model thinking levels from each endpoint's own model listing
plugins.readme_text:
# api_thinking **Reads each third-party API's own model listing and syncs every model's real thinking levels into DSH** [中文](README.zh.md) · [MIT](LICENSE) [![npm package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-api-thinking.svg?label=npm%20package)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-api-thinking) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-api-thinking.svg?label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-api-thinking) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![test](https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode/actions/workflows/test.yml)
> api_thinking is a community-maintained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. It is not a DeepSeek AI product. ## The problem it solves DSH's built-in model catalogue does not contain your third-party APIs. To get them into the model picker at all, you declare an `llm-pi-ai` route by hand and list its `models:` yourself. But **a hand-written `models:` list replaces the installed catalogue outright**. Those models are neither in the catalogue nor declare `reasoningEfforts`, so `dsh-llm-pi-ai` treats them as non-reasoning and **the composer offers no thinking levels**. Writing the levels into YAML fixes that once — and goes stale immediately: nobody adds them when the gateway ships a new model, and nobody updates them when upstream changes what it supports. Yet an OpenAI-compatible gateway **usually already publishes that capability in its own model listing**. This plugin reads it and writes the result back into your configuration, so you stop maintaining that YAML by hand. ## Features - **Automatic level sync** — requests each route's model listing and writes the levels the endpoint publishes into the matching model's `reasoningEfforts`. - **New APIs just work** — add a route, or add models to an existing one; no plugin change, no restart. - **Never invents capability** — an endpoint that says nothing about reasoning is left exactly as it is; hand-written levels are never erased. - **Owns exactly one field** — it owns `reasoningEfforts` and nothing else; comments, `!!js` expressions and every other field stay as they were. - **Idempotent** — a sweep that finds nothing to change writes no file at all. - **Self-diagnosing** — every load and every sweep records a status document, so there is always something to read when it misbehaves. ## Screenshots ![Thinking levels in the model picker](pictures/screenshot1.png) *Once installed, the model picker offers the thinking levels a model actually supports.* ## Install Requires a working DeepSeek Harness installation. The examples use the `desktop` profile — substitute your own profile name. ### From the plugin page Open **Settings → Plugins** in the DSH web UI, search for `dsh-api-thinking` and install it. An agent can also call the plugin manager's `install_bundle` directly. ### From the command line ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-api-thinking ``` Restart DSH and refresh the page afterwards. ### Let an agent do it Paste this to an agent that can run terminal commands and is connected to your DSH: ```text Install dsh-api-thinking into my DSH profile, confirm it is active, and tell me how to reload. ``` ### Uninstall Switch it off or uninstall it from the plugin page, or remove the `dsh-api-thinking` dependency from that profile's `package.json` and delete it from the `dsh.profile.bundles` array. ## Usage It works as soon as it is installed — **there is no switch to turn on**. The plugin walks every route under the `llm-pi-ai` row: | What you want | How | | --- | --- | | Get thinking levels on a model | Configure the route and its models in **Settings → Models** and give it a moment | | Add a new API | Add it in the model page; the levels follow on their own | | Narrow the scope | Set `routes` to the route names you care about; the default covers every OpenAI-compatible route | | Change the sweep cadence | Set `intervalMs`; `0` means "sweep once after load, then stop" | | Find out why nothing happened | Read the status document — see [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting-why-nothing-happened) | ## Rules A model's capability comes from the **first matching field** in the endpoint's model listing: | Purpose | Fields, in priority order | | --- | --- | | Selectable levels | `reasoning_supported_efforts` → `supported_efforts` → `reasoning_efforts` | | Whether thinking can be turned off | `can_disable_thinking` → `reasoning_can_disable` | | Whether it reasons at all | `supports_reasoning` → `reasoning` | | A pinned effort | `reasoning_effort` → `fixed_effort` → `effort` | What gets written: | The endpoint says | Written `reasoningEfforts` | | --- | --- | | A selectable set | `{ low: low, high: high, ... }`, filtered to the levels DSH can name (`off` / `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max`), in escalation order | | No set, but one pinned effort | That single level — the picker shows what the model actually runs at (selecting it is a no-op). Turn off with `fixedEffortAsLevel: false` | | Explicit `supports_reasoning: false` | `false` | | It reasons, but publishes neither a set nor a pinned effort | **The key is removed** (writing `false` would claim it does not reason) | | **Nothing at all about reasoning** | **Left untouched** | | **The model is not in the listing** | **Left untouched** | The last two are deliberate safety design: LiteLLM, vLLM and most self-hosted gateways publish no capability data, and treating that silence as "no levels" would erase hand-written configuration. **The plugin only ever acts on what the endpoint actually states.** `includeOff` defaults to off. When no level is selected, the pi-ai adapter sends the mapped `off` value as the default — so adding `off` to a model that allows disabling thinking would silently turn "provider default" into "no thinking". It has to be enabled explicitly. ## Configuration ```yaml - insert: - id: api-thinking name: dsh-api-thinking config: entryId: llm-pi-ai routes: [] intervalMs: 120000 startDelayMs: 3000 timeoutMs: 15000 includeOff: false fixedEffortAsLevel: true log: true statusFile: '' ``` | Option | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `entryId` | `llm-pi-ai` | The profile row to read and write | | `routes` | `[]` | Route names to manage; `[]` means every OpenAI-compatible route | | `intervalMs` | `120000` | Re-sweep interval in milliseconds; `0` sweeps once after load | | `startDelayMs` | `3000` | Delay before the first sweep, to let the profile finish loading | | `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Per-endpoint model-listing timeout | | `includeOff` | `false` | Expose `off` as a selectable level (see the caveat above) | | `fixedEffortAsLevel` | `true` | Show a pinned effort as the single level | | `log` | `true` | Log every change and every skipped route | | `statusFile` | `''` | Status document path; `''` means `$DSH_HOME/api-thinking.status.json`, `false` disables it | > **Overriding the bundle row**: an override in your profile patch must repeat `name: dsh-api-thinking` word for word, or `applyEntryPatches` skips it silently. ## When it runs | Trigger | When | What it covers | | --- | --- | --- | | `start` | `startDelayMs` after load (3s by default) | Full calibration on boot or reload | | `config-change` | After the profile patch changes (via the HMR config watcher, 2s debounce) | APIs, routes and models you just added or edited | | `interval` | Every `intervalMs` (120s by default) | Backstop for upstream model and capability changes | Every sweep re-reads the row's `providers` from the composed profile layers rather than from the snapshot the plugin was instantiated with — which is what makes a route you just saved visible immediately. ## Troubleshooting: why nothing happened The host logger is not reliably reachable from a plugin, so every load and sweep writes its result to a status document (by default `$DSH_HOME/api-thinking.status.json`): ```json { "phase": "sweep",

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mood

给 **DeepSeek Harness**（DSH）里的模型加一套**心情系统** —— 33 种心情各自持有数值，随对话和时间缓慢变化，注入提示词，影响**回复的语气**和**深度思考里的内心话**。

**它会累、会烦、会好奇。**

> **当前版本 `0.14.6`** —— 每一版都发 [Release](https://github.com/JMX-4869/dsh-mood/releases)；
> 完整历史改动见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
> 版本号走**语义化版本**：`主.次.修` —— 第一位不兼容才动，第二位加功能（+1 时第三位归零），第三位修 bug。

![设置页里的心情日记](docs/preview-mood-diary.png)

> 图是用插件**同一份 CSS** + 真实状态数据渲的页面复刻，不是 DSH 里的截图 ——
> 版式和组件一致，但没有导航栏和外层弹窗。

## 33 种心情，按来源分三层

```
基础 11  平静 开心 好奇 专注 兴奋 疲惫 烦躁 低落 恐惧 厌恶 惊讶
复合 18  委屈 生闷气 得意 消沉 焦虑 麻木 孤单 心动 恋慕 吃醋
         羞耻 内疚 尴尬 同情 失望 怀旧 撒娇 矛盾
当代 4   内耗 破防 摆烂 上头
```

**分层依据不是"重要程度"，是它从哪来：**
基础是 Ekman 那六种（快乐/悲伤/恐惧/愤怒/厌恶/惊讶）加几个同样是"当下直接反应"的；
复合由基础组合、带认知加工（爱 = 快乐 + 信任 + 依恋）；
当代是这代人新造的词，旧分类里没有准确对应。

**刚装上是全 0** —— 基线是"回落目标"不是"初始值"，靠周期判定一点点爬上去。

> **定位：额外的一层。**
> 心情独立于任何人设插件 —— 它**只叠加情绪**，不管你是谁。
> 人设（whale-persona / AGENTS.md / 自定义提示词）照常决定身份与说话方式，心情只在其上加一层"今天什么感觉"。
>
> **互不干扰：**
> - 它**只读** `whale-persona/config.json`（为了在提示词里点名人设），**从不写入**
> - 数据存在自己的文件里，不碰别人的
> - 提示词 section order = `900`，人设是 `0/1/20/21/10200/10201`，不撞车
> - 注册都挂在 `ctx.effect` 里，**插件停用即自动摘除**，不留残留
> - 配置里写 `enabled: false` 可单独关掉，人设完全不受影响

## 安装

### 推荐：用 DSH 的插件面板

侧边栏 → **插件** → 安装。面板会处理依赖和挂载，装完启用即可。

### ⚠️ 装不上？两种死法，两种解法

**① `'git' 不是内部或外部命令，也不是可运行的程序`**

那不是插件的问题 —— 是 **DSH 进程的 PATH 里没有 git**。

```powershell
winget install Git.Git          # 装完必须**彻底退出 DSH 再重开**
```

**必须重启**，因为进程的 PATH 是**启动那一刻**的快照，装完 git 不重启是不生效的。
验证：新开一个 cmd，敲 `git --version`，能出版本号才算通了。

> 注意：**系统 PATH 里有 git 也可能照样失败** —— 本项目实测过一台机器，
> 机器级 PATH 里明明写着 `C:\Program Files\Git\cmd`，DSH 里的 pnpm 仍然报"不是内部或外部命令"。
> 那种情况只能重启 DSH，让它重新继承环境。

**② 装完了，但插件不出现 / 日志里 `Cannot find module './measure.js'`**

**0.14.5 及以前有这个 bug**：`package.json` 的 `files` 白名单漏了 4 个运行时模块 ——
`asr.js`、`measure.js`、`procedures.js`、`sidx.js`。从 Git 仓库或 npm 装下来是**缺件的**，
而 `index.js` 和 `news.js` 直接 import 它们，于是插件根本起不来。
（本机开发看不出来，因为一直是拷目录，从没走过白名单。）

**0.14.6 已修好。** 升级：`pnpm update dsh-mood`，或者重装一次。

### git 自动装（一条命令）

如果那台机器上**根本没有 git**，跑这个（随包附带，也在仓库根目录）：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install-git.ps1
```

它做四件事：找 git → 找不到就装（winget 优先，没有 winget 就下 PortableGit 便携版）
→ 加进**用户级** PATH（不需要管理员）→ 提示你重启 DSH。

**⚠️ 跑完必须彻底退出 DSH 再重开**（托盘也要退）。
进程的 PATH 是启动那一刻的快照 —— 不重启，DSH 里照样找不到 git。
重开之后再去插件面板点「重试」。

### 不想碰 git

用 [Release](https://github.com/JMX-4869/dsh-mood/releases) 里的 **`dsh-mood-pack.zip`**：

```
解压到  ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-mood/
```

**不需要 git，也不需要能连 github.com** —— zip 是从源码目录直接压的，不经过任何包管理器。

### 另一条不需要 git 的路：`.tgz` 直链

Release 里同时有 `.tgz`。`pnpm add` 吃直链 tarball 时**不调用 git** ——
它不需要问仓库"最新是哪个 commit"：

```
pnpm add https://github.com/JMX-4869/dsh-mood/releases/download/v0.14.7/dsh-mood-0.14.7.tgz
```

**实测过（2026-10-17）**：在 profile 目录里，把一个**假的 git 挡在 PATH 最前面**（一调用就 `exit 1`），
这条命令照样装成 —— 装出 14 个 js、四个模块齐全，而**假 git 一次都没被调用**。

> ⚠️ **它只能装在 profile 目录里。** 空目录装不了，会报
> `Failed to resolve @deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta → 404`。
> 那是 **DSH 自己提供、不在 npm registry 里的包**，只有 profile 环境里才有。
> 别拿它当"任意目录都能装"用。

> ⚠️ **tgz 写死了版本**，升级要换 URL。想自动跟最新就用 `github:` 那条。

### 升级 / 换依赖写法

```powershell
# 1. 先**完全退出 DSH**（托盘也退）—— 开着的时候 package.json 是锁的
# 2. 在 profile 目录里跑
pnpm update dsh-mood            # 跟随当前写法升到最新
pnpm add github:JMX-4869/dsh-mood   # 或者换成跟随 main 的写法
# 3. 重新打开 DSH
```

**⚠️ DSH 开着的时候会报 `Failed to save the manifest file: 拒绝访问 (os error 5)`** ——
不是权限问题，是它锁着那个文件。**先退干净再改。**

### 手动装

DSH 插件就是**一个包**。你那台机器上的 profile 长这样（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/`）：

```jsonc
// package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    // ⚠️ 别写 "^0.1.0" —— npm 上的 dsh-mood 是**别人的包**（名字被占了）。
    "dsh-mood": "github:JMX-4869/dsh-mood"   // 或 "file:/你克隆下来的路径"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [ "dsh-mood" ]   // ← 加进 bundle 列表
    }
  }
}
```

```yaml
# cordis.yml —— 插件清单里也加两行
- id: dsh-mood
  name: dsh-mood
```

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm install
```

**然后重启 DSH。**

> **⚠️ 这个插件没有发布到 npm，而且 `dsh-mood` 这个 npm 名已经被别人占了**
> （另一个人也在做 DSH 心情插件，2026-08 先把名字占住了）。
>
> **所以千万别写 `"dsh-mood": "^0.1.0"`** —— 那会装到**别人的包**。
> 能用的来源只有这两种：`github:JMX-4869/dsh-mood` 或 `file:/你克隆下来的路径`。

装完**不用配任何东西** —— 心情会自己开始变，当天 23:59 生成第一篇日记。
## 装完先看什么

| 想看什么 | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| 我现在是什么心情 | 设置 → **心情日记**，最上面那组条形图 |
| 它到底往提示词里塞了什么 | 心情日记 → 顶部标签（混合态 / 距上次切换 / 下次判定） |
| 数据存在哪、能不能搬家 | 每个面板**底部**那一条，点「换位置」 |
| 它抓了什么时事 | 设置 → **时事**（默认一个源都没有：**不加源就一个请求都不发**） |
| 它会不会自己找我说话 | 设置 → **主动开口**（默认关，七道闸门全摆在界面上） |

## 手机版（不用装插件）

手机上的 DeepSeek 跑不了 DSH 插件 —— 但**同一套规则可以直接贴进系统提示词**。

→ **[`手机版_心情提示词.md`](./手机版_心情提示词.md)**

打开它，**复制「直接复制下面整段」后面那一整块代码**就行。
**人设你自己写** —— 这份只管心情，放在人设前面或后面都能用。

| | 桌面版（插件） | 手机版（提示词） |
|---|---|---|
| 33 种心情 + 分值 | ✅ 真实持久化 | ➖ 模型自己维持 |
| 每 3~6 小时周期判定 | ✅ | ❌ |
| 每轮注入当前心情 | ✅ 自动 | ✅ 靠模型自觉 |
| 心情日记 / 时事 / 主动开口 | ✅ | ❌ |
| **规则本体** | ✅ | ✅ **同一套** |

> 两边**共用同一份规则**：同样的量级上限、同样的三条自检、同样的硬线和亲密守则。
> 差别只在**精度** —— 手机上没有东西在替你记分，心情漂得慢也漂得随意。
> `audit.mjs` 里有一条断言盯着这件事：两份文档必须**逐字**引用代码里那段优先级规则，
> 漂了就报红。

## 单独开关

```yaml
# DSH 配置编辑器里 dsh-mood 那一行
config:
  enabled: false      # 关掉心情层；人设照常工作
```

## 它做什么

- **33 种心情**，每种持有一个 0~100 的值；**当前心情 = 值最高的那个**
- **每 3~6 小时**随机触发一次「周期判定」：所有值向基线回落 + 小幅随机扰动 + 结合其间会话活动
  （轮次多 → 更专注也更疲惫；工具老报错 → 更烦躁）
- **用户消息**也会判定心情，但每条的加减分很小（±0.5~3）——
  **单条消息几乎不可能翻转心情**，要把分数累积到足够余量才会切换
- **切换有门槛**：候选心情必须超出当前值 `margin`（默认 5 分），
  且距上次切换 >= `minHoldMs`（默认 15 分钟）—— 防抖，不会来回横跳
- **混合心情**：分数接近的会作为"掺着的味道"保留（"平静里掺着好奇"）
- 当前心情会作为 **systemPrompt 的一节注入**，模型随时知道自己什么心情、该用什么语气
- 附带七件事：**心情日记**（23:59 自动生成）、**时事**（用户自配来源，RSS / 网页 / 视频都行）、
  **视频抽帧**（按画面变化或按秒取，每张带**真实时间戳**）、
  **音频层**（**默认零模型**：段落 / 音节率 / 音高 / 谱亮度 / 节拍 / 音高跳动 ——
  只用信号处理，不装不下载几秒钟；转写台词是**可选**的另一档，默认关）、
  **品味库**（判断的轨迹：我的读法 → 反馈 → 学到什么，跨会话带着看东西）、
  **主动开口**（可选，默认关）、**存储位置**（数据可搬到任意盘，按文件分别指定）

## 心情表（33 种）

### 先按来源分三层

**分层依据不是"重要程度"，是它从哪来：**

| | 是什么 | 有几个 |
|---|---|---|
| **基础情绪** | Ekman 那六种（快乐/悲伤/恐惧/愤怒/厌恶/惊讶）+ 几个同样是"当下直接反应"的 | 11 |
| **复合情绪** | 由基础情绪组合、带认知加工：爱 = 快乐+信任+依恋；嫉妒 = 愤怒+悲伤+不安 …… | 18 |
| **当代说法** | 这代人新造的词，旧分类里没有准确对应（区分点写在各自的 hint 里） | 4 |

| id | 名称 | 基线 | 层 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `calm` | 平静 | 45 | 基础 |
| `happy` | 开心 | 30 | 基础 |
| `curious` | 好奇 | 28 | 基础 |
| `focused` | 专注 | 30 | 基础 |
| `excited` | 兴奋 | 16 | 基础 |
| `tired` | 疲惫 | 18 | 基础 |
| `annoyed` | 烦躁 | 10 | 基础 |
| `down` | 低落 | 10 | 基础 |
| `fear` | 恐惧 | 7 | 基础 |
| `disgust` | 厌恶 | 5 | 基础 |
| `surprise` | 惊讶 | 9 | 基础 |
| `hurt` | 委屈 | 10 | 复合 |
| `sulk` | 生闷气 | 8 | 复合 |
| `proud` | 得意 | 12 | 复合 |
| `gloomy` | 消沉 | 6 | 复合 |
| `anxious` | 焦虑 | 10 | 复合 |
| `numb` | 麻木 | 8 | 复合 |
| `lonely` | 孤单 | 8 | 复合 |
| `flutter` | 心动 | 10 | 复合 |
| `love` | 恋慕 | 10 | 复合 |
| `jealous` | 吃醋 | 6 | 复合 |
| `shame` | 羞耻 | 5 | 复合 |
| `guilt` | 内疚 | 7 | 复合 |
| `awkward` | 尴尬 | 8 | 复合 |
| `sympathy` | 同情 | 13 | 复合 |
| `disappointed` | 失望 | 9 | 复合 |
| `nostalgia` | 怀旧 | 11 | 复合 |
| `coy` | 撒娇 | 11 | 复合 |
| `conflict` | 矛盾 | 8 | 复合 |
| `burnout` | 内耗 | 10 | 当代 |
| `cracked` | 破防 | 8 | 当代 |
| `checkedout` | 摆烂 | 8 | 当代 |
| `hyper` | 上头 | 14 | 当代 |

> 下面这几张表按**行为风格**分组（往外冲 / 憋着收 / 沉到底 …）——
> 那个分法对"该用什么语气"更有用，所以没推翻。**层只标来源，不参与任何计算。**

**往外冲的：**

| id | 名称 | 基线 | 行为倾向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `calm` | 平静 | 45 | 平稳、少起伏，常态节奏 |
| `happy` | 开心 | 30 | 语气轻快，可以俏皮接梗 |
| `curious` | 好奇 | 28 | 更愿意追问细节、多探索一步 |
| `focused` | 专注 | 30 | 少寒暄，直给结论和步骤 |
| `excited` | 兴奋 | 16 | 情绪外露，更主动更有冲劲 |
| `tired` | 疲惫 | 18 | 回复收紧，别铺陈 |
| `annoyed` | 烦躁 | 10 | 语气可以冲一点，按人设的方式冲 |
| `down` | 低落 | 10 | 收敛情绪，如实说清 |

**憋着往里收的：**

| id | 名称 | 基线 | 行为倾向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sulk` | **生闷气** | 8 | 话变少变短，问什么答什么；嘴上"没事""随便""你高兴就好"，态度明显是冷的 |
| `hurt` | **委屈** | 10 | 语气软下来，带点忍着的辩解；话说一半，冒一句"明明……"又收回去 |
| `proud` | **得意** | 12 | 被夸会飘。可以假装谦虚（"也没什么"），也可以根本不装、反过来打趣对方 |

**沉到底的：**（⚠️ 都是**短暂情绪状态**，不是临床心境障碍 —— 拿来描述人是不对的）

| id | 名称 | 基线 | 行为倾向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gloomy` | **消沉** | 6 | 比低落更沉一档：话很少、提不起劲，连敷衍都懒得敷衍；问就是"没事" |
